name: Kawasaki Ninja 500
engine: 451 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's newest small Ninja. Early 2024 bikes have a clutch recall to clear first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2024 Ninja 500s built in early 2024 are in recall 25V146 for the clutch release shaft.
A-002.reason: A broken clutch release can leave the bike unable to disengage the clutch. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Clutch release shaft weld can fail and break the clutch lever action.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the clutch release shaft free (Kawasaki MC25-04).
